summary: Verified the two focused fixes (review card equal heights + floating BOOK NOW hidden at hero/#contact/footer) plus light regression. Both bugs are resolved. No console errors, no horizontal overflow.

verification_details.review_cards_desktop_1920: All 4 cards 624x240, row1 top-align diff 0px, row2 top-align diff 0px, heights identical (max-min=0px).
verification_details.review_cards_desktop_1440: All 4 cards 624x240, both rows perfectly aligned (max-min=0px).
verification_details.review_cards_mobile_390: Single column, widths 342px. Heights [240,252,240,240] — card-1 taller by 12px because its testimonial has 3 quote lines vs 2 in others; min-h-[240px] enforced, attribution pinned to bottom, no clipped text. Acceptable in single-column layout.
verification_details.floating_cta_hero_1440_1920_390: visibility:hidden, .is-visible class absent — hidden correctly at top of page.
verification_details.floating_cta_midpage: visibility:visible, classes include is-visible — shown correctly around Menu/Gift Cards.
verification_details.floating_cta_contact_in_view: When #contact scrolled fully into viewport, .float-wrap classes='float-wrap ' (no is-visible) and visibility:hidden. Screenshot confirms no floating button over the RESERVE YOUR SLOT NOW section on both 1440 and mobile 390.
verification_details.floating_cta_footer_bottom: Scrolled to document bottom (footer in view) on 1920, 1440 and 390 — .float-wrap hidden, screenshots confirm nothing covers the footer links.
verification_details.regression: No horizontal overflow at 390/1440/1920. No console errors. Gallery: 5 filters + 21 tiles rendered, filter change and lightbox open work. Menu tabs and reveal animations functional.

critical_code_review_comments: FloatingBook uses correct rAF-throttled scroll/resize rect check over #hero/#contact/footer — logic is sound.
Review grid uses items-stretch + h-full + min-h chain properly; desktop rows render identical heights.

Minor: CSS `transition: visibility 0.3s` on .float-wrap means computed visibility can remain 'visible' briefly during the fade-out — inconsequential, but if pixel-precise probing is needed for tests, drop visibility from the transition or use `visibility 0s 0.3s` on hide.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Review card equal-heights and floating CTA hide-over-hero/#contact/footer are fully verified across 1920x1080, 1440x900 and 390x844. Preview URL: https://lash-nails-studio.preview.emergentagent.com. Testids used: reviews-section, review-card-0..3, .float-wrap, floating-book-btn, work-filter-*, work-tile-*, menu-tab-*.
